non_secret_variables.name: NUTSNEWS_BACKEND_HOST
non_secret_variables.purpose: Backend host IPv4 address used by readiness checks and provider configuration.

non_secret_variables.name: NUTSNEWS_BACKEND_DOMAIN
non_secret_variables.purpose: Backend DNS name managed by backend routing workflows.

non_secret_variables.name: NUTSNEWS_BACKEND_ENVIRONMENT
non_secret_variables.purpose: Stable environment label for metrics, logs, reports, and automation.

non_secret_variables.name: NUTSNEWS_BACKEND_RESTIC_PROVIDER
non_secret_variables.purpose: Selected restic backend credential group. Supported values: s3, b2.

non_secret_variables.name: NUTSNEWS_REPORT_SMTP_PORT
non_secret_variables.purpose: SMTP port for backend reporting mail.

non_secret_variables.name: NUTSNEWS_REPORT_SMTP_STARTTLS
non_secret_variables.purpose: Whether backend reporting mail should use STARTTLS.

secrets.name: NUTSNEWS_BACKEND_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.purpose: Private key allowed to SSH to 65.75.201.18 for backend Ansible runs.

secrets.name: NUTSNEWS_BACKEND_KNOWN_HOSTS
secrets.purpose: Verified known_hosts entry for 65.75.201.18.

secrets.name: NUTSNEWS_BACKEND_ANSIBLE_USER
secrets.purpose: Optional SSH user override for Ansible automation.

secrets.name: NUTSNEWS_BACKEND_BECOME_PASSWORD
secrets.purpose: Optional sudo password for early bootstrap only; prefer passwordless sudo for a dedicated automation user.

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Scoped Cloudflare API token with DNS edit access to the nutsnews.com zone and zone read access.

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
secrets.purpose: Cloudflare account id for account-scoped APIs and future edge controls.

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID
secrets.purpose: Cloudflare zone id for nutsnews.com.

secrets.name: GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Grafana service account token for dashboard and alert provisioning.

secrets.name: GRAFANA_CLOUD_PROMETHEUS_URL
secrets.purpose: Grafana Cloud Prometheus remote_write URL.

secrets.name: GRAFANA_CLOUD_PROMETHEUS_PASSWORD

secrets.name: GRAFANA_CLOUD_LOKI_URL
secrets.purpose: Grafana Cloud Loki push endpoint.

secrets.name: GRAFANA_CLOUD_LOKI_USERNAME
secrets.purpose: Grafana Cloud Loki username or instance id.

secrets.name: GRAFANA_CLOUD_LOKI_PASSWORD

secrets.name: SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Supabase personal access token for CLI and Management API automation.

secrets.name: NUTSNEWS_PRODUCTION_SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF
secrets.purpose: Production Supabase project reference.

secrets.name: NUTSNEWS_PRODUCTION_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.purpose: Production Supabase project API URL.

secrets.name: NUTSNEWS_PRODUCTION_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.purpose: Production Supabase anon key used for public read compatibility checks.

secrets.name: NUTSNEWS_PRODUCTION_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.purpose: Production Supabase service role key used only in protected automation.

secrets.name: NUTSNEWS_PRODUCTION_SUPABASE_DB_URL
secrets.purpose: Production Postgres connection URL for backup/restore and migration planning. Must never be printed.

secrets.name: RESTIC_REPOSITORY
secrets.purpose: Restic repository location.

secrets.name: RESTIC_PASSWORD
secrets.purpose: Restic repository encryption password.

credential_sets.description: Backblaze B2 object storage for restic.

conditional_secrets.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
conditional_secrets.purpose: S3-compatible access key id when NUTSNEWS_BACKEND_RESTIC_PROVIDER=s3.

conditional_secrets.name: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
conditional_secrets.purpose: S3-compatible secret access key when NUTSNEWS_BACKEND_RESTIC_PROVIDER=s3.

conditional_secrets.name: AWS_DEFAULT_REGION
conditional_secrets.purpose: S3-compatible default region when needed by the provider.

conditional_secrets.name: B2_ACCOUNT_ID
conditional_secrets.purpose: Backblaze B2 account id when NUTSNEWS_BACKEND_RESTIC_PROVIDER=b2.

conditional_secrets.name: B2_ACCOUNT_KEY
conditional_secrets.purpose: Backblaze B2 account key when NUTSNEWS_BACKEND_RESTIC_PROVIDER=b2.

secrets.name: NUTSNEWS_REPORT_SMTP_HOST
secrets.purpose: SMTP host for backend reporting mail.

secrets.name: NUTSNEWS_REPORT_SMTP_USERNAME
secrets.purpose: SMTP username for backend reporting mail.

secrets.name: NUTSNEWS_REPORT_SMTP_PASSWORD
secrets.purpose: SMTP password or API token for backend reporting mail.

secrets.name: NUTSNEWS_REPORT_EMAIL_FROM
secrets.purpose: From address for backend reports.

secrets.name: NUTSNEWS_REPORT_EMAIL_TO
secrets.purpose: Recipient address or comma-separated recipients for backend reports.

manual_provider_actions: Create a scoped Cloudflare API token in the Cloudflare dashboard.
Create Grafana Cloud service account/access-policy tokens in Grafana Cloud.
Create a Supabase personal access token and collect the production project ref/URL/API keys/database URL.
Create or choose the restic object-storage repository and provider credentials.
Create or choose SMTP/reporting provider credentials.
Approve production-backend environment deployments when GitHub prompts for production mutation.
